name: A São Paulo courtyard

place_source.title: Wikidata: São Paulo (Q174), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A walled courtyard in the São Paulo highlands, paved round a planted bed of araucaria, cedro-japonês and ipê with fruit trees and a clipped cipreste hedge: loud with caturritas and bem-te-vis by day, visited after dark by an opossum, a house gecko and a marmoset.

facts.text: São Paulo has a humid subtropical climate (Köppen Cfa, bordering on Cwa), with hot rainy summers and mild winters in which frosts occur in some years.

source.title: Wikipedia: São Paulo
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "São Paulo", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The city lies on a plateau beyond the Serra do Mar, part of the Brazilian Highlands, at an average elevation of about 799 m; rainfall averages 1,658 mm a year.

source.title: Wikipedia: São Paulo
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "São Paulo", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The rufous-bellied thrush (sabiá-laranjeira) is the state bird of São Paulo since 1966 and is one of the most common birds across southeastern Brazil.

source.title: Wikipedia: Rufous-bellied thrush
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Rufous-bellied thrush", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The sayaca tanager (sanhaçu) adapts readily to the urban environment as long as some arboreal cover and a supply of fruit are available, and is among the commonest urban birds in southeastern Brazil.

source.title: Wikipedia: Sayaca tanager
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Sayaca tanager", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The plain parakeet (caturrita) is endemic to Brazil and is gregarious in flocks of 15 to 20 birds; it builds its own communal nest cavities in termite nests.

source.title: Wikipedia: Caturrita
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Caturrita", Portuguese Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: São Paulo is the capital of Brazil's most populous state, and its metropolitan area is the most populous in Brazil, with 21.1 million inhabitants across 39 municipalities at the 2014 census.

source.title: Wikipedia: São Paulo
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "São Paulo", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: São Paulo municipality had 11,895,893 inhabitants at the most recent census recorded on Wikidata.
The black-tufted marmoset ranges from Bahia to Paraná and as far inland as Goiás, and can commonly be seen in the city of Rio de Janeiro, where it has been introduced.
